generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
rateLimited: You're doing that too often. Wait a moment and try again.
forbidden: You don't have permission to do that.
slug_taken: That workspace URL is already taken.
invitation_invalid: This invitation is no longer valid.
invitation_expired: This invitation has expired. Ask an organization admin for a new one.
invitation_email_mismatch: This invitation was sent to a different email address.
candidate_not_active: Turn on matching for this candidate before submitting them.
job_not_open_for_referrals: This job is no longer open to referrals.
sharing_authorization_missing: Record the candidate's authorization to share with this recipient for this job first.
invalid_disclosure_fields: Select at least one field to share.
duplicate_referral: You already submitted this candidate to this job. Open it from your sent referrals.
document_not_shareable: One of the selected documents hasn't passed the security scan yet.
stale_version: This record changed in the meantime. Refresh and try again.
invalid_transition: That status change isn't allowed from the current stage.
agreement_required: Both parties must confirm the collaboration agreement first.
agreement_not_pending: The agreement is not awaiting confirmation.
placement_locked: This placement can't be changed in its current state.
invoice_required: Record the client invoice before reporting a payment.
commission_not_payable: Commission becomes payable only after the client payment is verified.
four_eyes_required: Evidence must be verified by someone other than the person who recorded it.
already_reviewed: This evidence has already been reviewed.
payout_exceeds_balance: The payout exceeds the outstanding balance.
remittance_exceeds_balance: The remittance exceeds the outstanding platform balance.
owner_not_member: The owner must be an active member of this organization.
tenant_mismatch: That record doesn't belong to this organization.
immutable_record: This record is immutable. Record a correcting entry instead.

page.title: Something went wrong
page.body: The error was logged. Try again, and contact support if it continues.
page.forbiddenTitle: You don't have access to this
page.forbiddenBody: Ask an organization admin if you need this permission.

notFound.title: This page isn't available
notFound.body: It doesn't exist, or you don't have access to it.

not_pipeline_owner: Only the person who accepted this referral can move it through the pipeline.
candidate_email_missing: Add an email to the candidate's profile to ask for confirmation by email.
request_closed: This request is no longer active.
request_expired: This link has expired. Ask the recruiter for a new one.
not_found: We couldn't find that. It may have been removed, or you don't have access.
identifier_required: Add an email, a phone number or a LinkedIn profile to this candidate, then submit again.
claim_window_closed: The objection deadline passed on {when} ET. You can still decline this referral for another reason.
claim_already_filed: An objection was already filed for this referral. Refresh to see it.
claim_not_allowed: You can't file an objection on this referral anymore. Refresh to see its current status.
claim_files_not_ready: Some files are still processing or can't be used. Wait until they're ready, or remove them.
claim_referral_invalid: That referral can't be used as evidence anymore. Pick another one, or upload files.
claim_file_invalid: This file can't be used. Upload a PDF, PNG or JPEG of up to 10 MB.
claim_too_many_files: You can attach up to 5 files.
claim_attestation_required: Confirm the statement to file the objection.
claim_date_invalid: Pick a date before this referral was delivered, within the dates shown under the field.
claim_evidence_invalid: Add evidence: upload at least one file, or pick an earlier referral.
claim_note_too_long: Keep the note to 2,000 characters or less.
contest_window_closed: The contest deadline passed on {when} ET. The objection is final.
dispute_already_open: A dispute is already open for this referral. A platform admin is reviewing it.
release_not_allowed: This candidate can't be released right now. Refresh to see the referral's current status.
invalid_dispute_kind: This action doesn't apply to this type of dispute.
terms_incomplete: Complete the terms for partners to open this job to partner referrals.
referrals_require_permanent: Only permanent jobs can be open to partner referrals. Change the contract type, or turn off partner referrals.
terms_attestation_required: Confirm you hold the fee agreement with the end client to publish these terms.
hire_terms_fixed: This referral's currency and guarantee come from its terms and can't be entered. Refresh and try again.
fee_difference_reason_required: Choose a reason for the different invoiced fee.
amendment_after_hire: A hire was already recorded. Terms can't be amended after a hire.
amendment_window_after_delivery: The ownership window can't change on a delivered referral. Keep the current window.
amendment_no_change: Change at least one term to record an amendment.
amendment_legacy_referral: This referral has no recorded terms to amend.
terms_not_recorded: This referral was sent before the terms card, so its fee, currency and guarantee are entered by hand. Refresh and try again.
hire_terms_changed: This referral's terms were amended while this form was open. Refresh the page to see the new terms, then record the hire again.
hire_not_eligible: A hire can't be recorded on this referral any more. Refresh the page to see why.
objection_open: Your prior-presentation objection on this referral is still open. Record the hire once it's decided.
client_name_required_for_referrals: Enter the client's real name to open this job to partners.
hire_dates_invalid: Enter a date within the allowed range shown under the start date.
hire_report_unavailable: You can't file a hire report on this referral right now.
hire_report_rate_limited: Your organization has reached the limit for hire reports. Try again later.
hire_already_recorded: {partner} already recorded this hire. You can see it on the placement.
hire_report_files_not_ready: Wait until every file is checked, then file again.
hire_report_answer_closed: The time to answer this report has ended. You can still record the hire.
hire_rebuttal_closed: You can't add a rebuttal: the time to add one has ended, or one was already sent.
auth_check_already_requested: An authorization check was already requested for this dispute.
